original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚奥孙州一名男子死于警局拘留室，家属要求调查
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥孙州Agbeye警察局拘留室内，一名男子Taofiki Mustapha死亡。据报他因被指偷窃可可豆荚被捕后移交警方。家属已向警方助理总监递交请愿书，要求调查死亡原因。警方发言人证实了事件，称死者系被社区人员抓获后交由警方。

key_facts.fact: 一名男子Taofiki Mustapha死于奥孙州Agbeye警察局拘留室
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The family of the late Taofiki Mustapha, who reportedly died in the custody of Agbeye Police Post

key_facts.fact: 家属向警方助理总监递交请愿书要求调查死亡原因
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: has called on the Assistant Inspector General of Police, Zone XI Command headquarters in Osogbo, Osun State, to probe the circumstances surrounding the incident

key_facts.fact: 死者因被指偷窃可可豆荚被社区人员抓获后移交警方
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: he was arrested by some people in Agbeye for allegedly stealing cocoa pods and handed over to the police

key_facts.fact: 警方发言人证实了该事件
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Confirming the incident, the Osun Police Command Public Relations Officer, Abiodun Ojelabi

uncertainties: 死亡具体原因尚未确认
偷窃指控仅为据称，尚未经证实
目前仅单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
